description: This file defines the LoggingCallbackManager class, which manages adding, removing, and categorizing callbacks for the litellm framework. It handles various callback types, enforces limits, and interacts with external modules for callback registration and configuration.

classes.name: LoggingCallbackManager
classes.description: A class that manages adding, removing, and categorizing callbacks for the litellm framework, including handling duplicates, limits, and callback types.

methods.name: add_litellm_input_callback
methods.description: Adds an input callback to litellm.input_callback list.

methods.name: add_litellm_service_callback
methods.description: Adds a service callback to litellm.service_callback list.

methods.name: add_litellm_callback
methods.description: Adds a general callback to litellm.callbacks list.

methods.name: add_litellm_success_callback
methods.description: Adds a success callback to litellm.success_callback list.

methods.name: add_litellm_failure_callback
methods.description: Adds a failure callback to litellm.failure_callback list.

methods.name: add_litellm_async_success_callback
methods.description: Adds an async success callback to litellm._async_success_callback list.

methods.name: add_litellm_async_failure_callback
methods.description: Adds an async failure callback to litellm._async_failure_callback list.

methods.name: remove_callback_from_list_by_object
methods.description: Removes callbacks associated with a specific object from a callback list.

methods.name: _add_string_callback_to_list
methods.description: Adds a string callback to a list if not already present.

methods.name: _check_callback_list_size
methods.description: Checks if adding another callback would exceed the MAX_CALLBACKS limit.

methods.name: _add_custom_callback_generic_api_str
methods.description: Handles adding a callback defined as a string, possibly creating a GenericAPILogger if configuration matches.

methods.name: _safe_add_callback_to_list
methods.description: Safely adds a callback to a list, handling different callback types and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _add_callback_function_to_list
methods.description: Adds a callback function to a list if not already present.

methods.name: _add_custom_logger_to_list
methods.description: Adds a CustomLogger instance to a list if an equivalent one isn't already present.

methods.name: _get_custom_logger_key
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a CustomLogger based on its class and fundamental attributes.

methods.name: _reset_all_callbacks
methods.description: Resets all callback lists to empty.

methods.name: _get_all_callbacks
methods.description: Returns all callbacks from various litellm callback lists.

methods.name: get_active_additional_logging_utils_from_custom_logger
methods.description: Retrieves all active callbacks that are instances of AdditionalLoggingUtils.

methods.name: get_custom_loggers_for_type
methods.description: Retrieves all active custom loggers of a specific type.

methods.name: callback_is_active
methods.description: Checks if any active callback is of a specified type.

methods.name: get_callbacks_by_type
methods.description: Categorizes active callbacks into success, failure, and success_and_failure groups.

methods.name: _get_callback_string
methods.description: Converts a callback object to its string representation.

methods.name: get_active_custom_logger_for_callback_name
methods.description: Retrieves the active custom logger for a given callback name.
